commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125
test "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/feat/outgoing-live-qa-20261125)" = "2cd0010be02ae660ee27815328f4c32d44932623"
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-single-app-XXXXXX)"
OUT="$(mktemp -d /tmp/aicalls-single-app-sign-XXXXXX)"
trap 'cd "$ROOT"; git worktree remove --force "$WORK" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "$OUT"' EXIT
git worktree add --detach "$WORK" "2cd0010be02ae660ee27815328f4c32d44932623"
cd "$WORK"
echo "QA_SHA=2cd0010be02ae660ee27815328f4c32d44932623"
echo STAGE=TARGETED_QA
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh preflight
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.calls.test_outgoing_qa scripts.tests.test_gsm_single_transport_contract scripts.tests.test_ux05_locale_accessibility scripts.tests.test_docs_check
bash scripts/bin/test-profile.sh focus app '*OutgoingQaSessionTest'
echo TARGETED_QA_PASS=true
echo STAGE=BUILD_SIGNED_MAIN_APP
if [[ -z "${ANDROID_HOME:-}" && -d "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk" ]]; then export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; fi
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease
UNSIGNED=app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk
test -s "$UNSIGNED"
SIGNER="$(find "$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/build-tools" -name apksigner -type f | sort -V | tail -1)"
ZIPALIGN="$(dirname "$SIGNER")/zipalign"
test -x "$SIGNER" && test -x "$ZIPALIGN"
"$ZIPALIGN" -f -p 4 "$UNSIGNED" "$OUT/aligned.apk"
SIGNED="$OUT/candidate.apk"
"$SIGNER" sign --ks "$HOME/.android/debug.keystore" --ks-key-alias androiddebugkey --ks-pass pass:android --key-pass pass:android --out "$SIGNED" "$OUT/aligned.apk"
"$SIGNER" verify "$SIGNED"
CERT="$("$SIGNER" verify --print-certs "$SIGNED" | sed -n 's/.*Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1)"
test "$CERT" = fb07493cf97b0a84ec410f7f72f12938b7f9d47151546e15c049c49c27807b11
echo SIGNED_MAIN_APP_READY=true
umask 077
CACHE="$HOME/.local/share/aicalls-qa/2cd0010be02ae660ee27815328f4c32d44932623"
mkdir -p "$CACHE"
cp "$SIGNED" "$CACHE/candidate.apk"
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$SIGNED" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$(shasum -a 256 "$CACHE/candidate.apk" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo SIGNED_CANDIDATE_RETAINED=true
echo STAGE=EXACT_PHONE_READ_ONLY
SERIAL="$(PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m aicall_tools.device.s22_adb_discovery --serial RFCT70L7E8J)"
PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge
ROLE="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cmd role get-role-holders --user 0 android.app.role.DIALER | tr -d '\r')"
test "$ROLE" = "$PKG"
STATE="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9]\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')"
MODE="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys audio | sed -n 's/.*Actual mode = \(MODE_[A-Z_]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r')"
test "$STATE" = 0 && test "$MODE" = MODE_NORMAL
PATHS="$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pm path "$PKG" | tr -d '\r')"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$PATHS" | grep -c '^package:')" = 1
REMOTE="$(printf '%s\n' "$PATHS" | sed -n 's/^package://p')"
adb -s "$SERIAL" pull "$REMOTE" "$OUT/previous.apk" >/dev/null
PREV_CERT="$("$SIGNER" verify --print-certs "$OUT/previous.apk" | sed -n 's/.*Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest: //p' | head -1)"
test "$PREV_CERT" = "$CERT"
cp "$OUT/previous.apk" "$CACHE/previous.apk"
echo PHONE_IDLE_AND_SIGNER_MATCH=true
echo ROLLBACK_APK_RETAINED=true
echo NO_INSTALL_NO_CALLS=true
echo "QA_SHA=2cd0010be02ae660ee27815328f4c32d44932623"
